test.create_query: CREATE TABLE group_by_two_level_few_keys ( lc LowCardinality(Nullable(String)), s Nullable(String), a UInt64, b UInt64, c UInt64 ) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY tuple()
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO group_by_two_level_few_keys SELECT v, v, intHash32(intDiv(number, 16)) % 13, 7, 11 FROM ( SELECT number, multiIf( intHash32(intDiv(number, 16)) % 100 < 40, 'category_value_01_aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa', intHash32(intDiv(number, 16)) % 100 < 70, 'category_value_02_bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb', intHash32(intDiv(number, 16)) % 100 < 95, 'category_value_03_cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc', intHash32(intDiv(number, 16)) % 100 < 97, NULL, concat('category_value_', toString((intHash32(number) % 9) + 4), '_dddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddd')) AS v FROM numbers_mt(300000000) )
test.query: SELECT lc FROM group_by_two_level_few_keys GROUP BY lc FORMAT Null
SELECT s FROM group_by_two_level_few_keys GROUP BY s FORMAT Null
SELECT a, b, c, count() FROM group_by_two_level_few_keys GROUP BY a, b, c FORMAT Null
